summary: A wordless real-time cooperative game where players control specific action types across all the shared heroes, racing against a sand timer to equip everyone and escape the maze without triggering an alarm. It's chaotic and often hilarious, since you can't talk and must instead tap the table or gesture to alert teammates.
praised: quick to teach, quick to play, and endlessly replayable
great energy and shared panic in a group setting
scales cleanly with modular board expansion for more players
criticised: the real-time pressure and silence rule aren't for everyone
can feel overwhelming or unfair at higher player counts
some find it more chaotic than genuinely strategic
base game content is thin without the expansions

interaction.detail: All players act on a single shared board and shared set of pawns, with each player restricted to only certain move types across all heroes, so success depends entirely on watching and silently cueing each other. There is no individual board at all — the whole game state is communal.

sources: Objectives completed as a team (no point values)
scoring.how_you_win: The team wins outright if all heroes gather their gear and reach the exit before the sand timer runs out or the vortex marker reaches the exploration deck; there is no score, only success or failure.

similar: Escape: The Curse of the Temple
